property_summary: For any caller without prior balance who calls airDrop, the reference contract always increases that caller's tokenBalance by exactly 20 (so tokenBalance(caller) == 20 afterwards); the mutant that adds 40 violates this by sometimes producing tokenBalance(caller) == 40.
change_summary: Replace the increment to add 40 instead of 20, doubling the amount awarded by airDrop and changing tokenBalance for the caller (and possibly other observations).
